verdict.rationale: Turso's docs focus on SQLite-compatible OLTP features (embedded replicas, branching, PITR, vector search) with no mention of analytical/OLAP optimizations, columnar storage, or dashboard-scale aggregation performance. Community evidence actually points the other way: users report missing window functions and 'deeply nested joins which overflow something,' both core to heavy analytical aggregations, suggesting the product is not built or proven for this workload.
